trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction call that ends in a booked appointment, but it's built on light-touch execution rather than deliberate technique — the rep moves through verify items efficiently and adapts well to the elderly customer's tech limitations, but leaves the co-owner/spouse gap, the 'grant' misconception, and the bill-flip all underdeveloped. The customer's warmth was present from early on and the rep didn't damage it, but also didn't fully capitalize on the emotional openings the customer gave him.
